descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Prizm trading card features Cooper Kupp, a talented player from the Los Angeles Rams football team. The card is a standard size and part of the base set. It is also a Prizm parallel/variety, which means it has a unique design that makes it stand out from other cards in the set. The card number is 165 and it was manufactured in the United States by Panini. 

This sports trading card is perfect for any NFL fan or collector who wants to add to their collection. It is in excellent condition and ready for display or storage. Don't miss your chance to own a piece of football history with this 2023 Panini Prizm Cooper Kupp trading card.
